limitations: No calibrated Mars EVA physiology or suit-consumption model.
No soil-strength, calibrated rockfall or meter-scale thermal slip prediction.
Seeded uniform samples are imposed assumptions, not measured probabilities.
Map exactness is only for this static cropped graph and time-monotone resource model.
Real local boulder accuracy, vertical accuracy and registration error remain unmeasured.
